# Keyboard map

Hold Option (Alt) for the large character. Add Shift for the small character above it. The small label at the bottom is the ordinary key.

Orange borders mark dead keys. Release Option before typing the next key. Repeat the same Option chord, or press Space, to enter the dead key's own character. Follow-ups can be sequences, such as `-1` for a negative superscript or subscript.

| Key | Double-tap | Follow-ups |
|---|---|---|
| <code>1</code> | <code>¨</code> | <code>t</code>:<code>⍤</code>; <code>o</code>:<code>⍥</code>; <code>g</code>:<code>⍢</code>; <code>8</code>:<code>⍣</code>; <code>&#96;</code>:<code>⍨</code> |
| <code>5</code> | <code>_</code> | <code>0–9</code>:<code>₀–₉</code>; <code>x</code>:<code>ₓ</code>; <code>j</code>:<code>ⱼ</code>; <code>e</code>:<code>ₑ</code>; <code>r</code>:<code>ᵣ</code>; <code>-0–9</code>:<code>₋₀–₋₉</code> |
| <code>6</code> | <code>^</code> | <code>0–9</code>:<code>⁰–⁹</code>; <code>-0–9</code>:<code>⁻⁰–⁻⁹</code>; <code>t</code>:<code>ᵀ</code>; <code>u</code>:<code>ᵘ</code> |
| <code>-</code> | <code>¯</code> | <code>,</code>:<code>⍪</code>; <code>&#92;</code>:<code>⍀</code>; <code>/</code>:<code>⌿</code>; <code>a</code>:<code>⍶</code>; <code>w</code>:<code>⍹</code>; <code>7</code>:<code>⍙</code>; <code>&#96;</code>:<code>⍚</code>; <code>0</code>:<code>⊼</code>; <code>9</code>:<code>⊽</code>; <code>e</code>:<code>⍷</code>; <code>i</code>:<code>⍸</code>; <code>z</code>:<code>⊆</code> |
| <code>=</code> | <code>≡</code> | <code>/</code>:<code>≢</code> |
| <code>q</code> | <code>⎕</code> | <code>t</code>:<code>⌻</code>; <code>=</code>:<code>⌸</code>; <code>u</code>:<code>⌹</code>; <code>&#96;</code>:<code>⌺</code>; <code>;</code>:<code>⍠</code>; <code>&#92;</code>:<code>⌷</code> |
| <code>o</code> | <code>○</code> | <code>-</code>:<code>⊖</code>; <code>&#92;</code>:<code>⍉</code>; <code>/</code>:<code>⊘</code>; <code>m</code>:<code>⊗</code>; <code>u</code>:<code>⨸</code>; <code>t</code>:<code>⌾</code>; <code>8</code>:<code>⍟</code>; <code>c</code>:<code>⍝</code>; <code>b</code>:<code>⍎</code>; <code>n</code>:<code>⍕</code> |
| <code>&#92;</code> | <code>⍭</code> | <code>7</code>:<code>⍋</code>; <code>g</code>:<code>⍒</code> |
| <code>k</code> | <code>↑</code> | <code>j</code>:<code>↕</code> |

This is the US-based map used in the browser and REPL, and by the native BasedPL-us macOS layout. Regional macOS layouts preserve their native Option characters and move conflicting BPL shortcuts. See [macOS installation](#macos-installation).

## macOS installation

From a BasedPL repository checkout, run `scripts/install-keyboard.sh` for the US layout. Pass `uk`, `de`, `fr` or `es` for British, German QWERTZ, French AZERTY or Spanish: for example, `scripts/install-keyboard.sh de`.

In System Settings, open Keyboard → Text Input → Edit, add `BasedPL-us` (or your chosen code), then select it from the input menu. If the layout isn't listed, log out and back in. `editors/macos/BasedPL-{code}.txt` lists each native layout's shortcuts.
